shortDescription: Module for setup of ControllerProperties Avi RESTful Object

options.name: allow_ip_forwarding
options.description: Field introduced in 17.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: allow_unauthenticated_apis
options.description: Allow unauthenticated access for special apis. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: allow_unauthenticated_nodes
options.description: Boolean flag to set allow_unauthenticated_nodes. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_idle_timeout
options.description: Allowed values are 0-1440. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 15.

options.name: api_perf_logging_threshold
options.description: Threshold to log request timing in portal_performance.log and server-timing response header. Any stage taking longer than 1% of the threshold will be included in the server-timing header. Field introduced in 18.1.4, 18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 10000.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: appviewx_compat_mode
options.description: Export configuration in appviewx compatibility mode. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: attach_ip_retry_interval
options.description: Number of attach_ip_retry_interval. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 360.

options.name: attach_ip_retry_limit
options.description: Number of attach_ip_retry_limit. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_disable_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Disable Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: bm_use_ansible
options.description: Use ansible for se creation in baremetal. Field introduced in 17.2.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: cleanup_expired_authtoken_timeout_period
options.description: Period for auth token cleanup job. Field introduced in 18.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: cleanup_sessions_timeout_period
options.description: Period for sessions cleanup job. Field introduced in 18.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: cloud_reconcile
options.description: Enable/disable periodic reconcile for all the clouds. Field introduced in 17.2.14,18.1.5,18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: cluster_ip_gratuitous_arp_period
options.description: Period for cluster ip gratuitous arp job. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: consistency_check_timeout_period
options.description: Period for consistency check job. Field introduced in 18.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: crashed_se_reboot
options.description: Number of crashed_se_reboot. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 900.

options.name: dead_se_detection_timer
options.description: Number of dead_se_detection_timer. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 360.

options.name: dns_refresh_period
options.description: Period for refresh pool and gslb dns job. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: dummy
options.description: Number of dummy.

options.name: enable_api_sharding
options.description: This setting enables the controller leader to shard api requests to the followers (if any). Field introduced in 18.1.5, 18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: enable_memory_balancer
options.description: Enable/disable memory balancer. Field introduced in 17.2.8. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: fatal_error_lease_time
options.description: Number of fatal_error_lease_time. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 120.

options.name: max_dead_se_in_grp
options.description: Number of max_dead_se_in_grp. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.

options.name: max_pcap_per_tenant
options.description: Maximum number of pcap files stored per tenant. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.

options.name: max_seq_attach_ip_failures
options.description: Maximum number of consecutive attach ip failures that halts vs placement. Field introduced in 17.2.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 3.

options.name: max_seq_vnic_failures
options.description: Number of max_seq_vnic_failures. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 3.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: persistence_key_rotate_period
options.description: Period for rotate app persistence keys job. Allowed values are 1-1051200. Special values are 0 - 'disabled'. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: portal_token
options.description: Token used for uploading tech-support to portal. Field introduced in 16.4.6,17.1.2.

options.name: process_locked_useraccounts_timeout_period
options.description: Period for process locked user accounts job. Field introduced in 18.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.

options.name: process_pki_profile_timeout_period
options.description: Period for process pki profile job. Field introduced in 18.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1440.

options.name: query_host_fail
options.description: Number of query_host_fail. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 180.

options.name: safenet_hsm_version
options.description: Version of the safenet package installed on the controller. Field introduced in 16.5.2,17.2.3.

options.name: se_create_timeout
options.description: Number of se_create_timeout. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 900.

options.name: se_failover_attempt_interval
options.description: Interval between attempting failovers to an se. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 300.

options.name: se_from_marketplace
options.description: This setting decides whether se is to be deployed from the cloud marketplace or to be created by the controller. The setting is applicable only when byol license is selected. Enum options - MARKETPLACE, IMAGE. Field introduced in 18.1.4, 18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as IMAGE.

options.name: se_offline_del
options.description: Number of se_offline_del. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 172000.

options.name: se_vnic_cooldown
options.description: Number of se_vnic_cooldown. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 120.

options.name: secure_channel_cleanup_timeout
options.description: Period for secure channel cleanup job. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: secure_channel_controller_token_timeout
options.description: Number of secure_channel_controller_token_timeout. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: secure_channel_se_token_timeout
options.description: Number of secure_channel_se_token_timeout. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: seupgrade_fabric_pool_size
options.description: Pool size used for all fabric commands during se upgrade. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 20.

options.name: seupgrade_segroup_min_dead_timeout
options.description: Time to wait before marking segroup upgrade as stuck. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 360.

options.name: ssl_certificate_expiry_warning_days
options.description: Number of days for ssl certificate expiry warning.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: unresponsive_se_reboot
options.description: Number of unresponsive_se_reboot. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 300.

options.name: upgrade_dns_ttl
options.description: Time to account for dns ttl during upgrade. This is in addition to vs_scalein_timeout_for_upgrade in se_group. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 5.

options.name: upgrade_lease_time
options.description: Number of upgrade_lease_time. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 360.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Unique object identifier of the object.

options.name: vnic_op_fail_time
options.description: Number of vnic_op_fail_time. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 180.

options.name: vs_apic_scaleout_timeout
options.description: Time to wait for the scaled out se to become ready before marking the scaleout done, applies to apic configuration only. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 360.

options.name: vs_awaiting_se_timeout
options.description: Number of vs_awaiting_se_timeout. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: vs_key_rotate_period
options.description: Period for rotate vs keys job. Allowed values are 1-1051200. Special values are 0 - 'disabled'. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 360.

options.name: vs_scaleout_ready_check_interval
options.description: Interval for checking scaleout_ready status while controller is waiting for scaleoutready rpc from the service engine. Field introduced in 18.2.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: vs_se_attach_ip_fail
options.description: Time to wait before marking attach ip operation on an se as failed. Field introduced in 17.2.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 600.

options.name: vs_se_bootup_fail
options.description: Number of vs_se_bootup_fail. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 480.

options.name: vs_se_create_fail
options.description: Number of vs_se_create_fail. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1500.

options.name: vs_se_ping_fail
options.description: Number of vs_se_ping_fail. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: vs_se_vnic_fail
options.description: Number of vs_se_vnic_fail. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 300.

options.name: vs_se_vnic_ip_fail
options.description: Number of vs_se_vnic_ip_fail. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 120.

options.name: warmstart_se_reconnect_wait_time
options.description: Number of warmstart_se_reconnect_wait_time. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 480.

options.name: warmstart_vs_resync_wait_time
options.description: Timeout for warmstart vs resync. Field introduced in 18.1.4, 18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 300.
